suggested_fix: No fix required. The error paths after aac_comm_init() and aac_fib_setup() failures free dev->queues and immediately set it to NULL, so a caller's later cleanup (e.g. kfree(aac->queues) in the probe error path) cannot double-free it. As a hardening measure, the values the adapter reports (status[1..4]) could be range-checked before they are used to size max_fib_size, sg_tablesize and can_queue.
